procedures.procedure_description: The drone will fall out of the sky, but this is better than a mid-air collision.

procedures.checklist_entry: Threatening wildlife: get in car, RTH, controller out window
procedures.procedure_description: Keep the controller outside if possible to maintain signal.

procedures.checklist_entry: Fly-away: orient antenna overhead, switch flight mode, kill switch, call ATC Tower (+254 116 388 564)
procedures.procedure_description: If switching flight mode fails, use kill switch. Inform ATC Tower of drone size, location, direction, height, speed, and remaining battery.

procedures.checklist_entry: Crew unfit: RTH, first aid, call radio room (+254 723 312 673)
procedures.procedure_description: Provide first aid. Keep calm and communicate clearly.
